text_block_list.text: The day of the Arima Kinen is finally here.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna beat you and become the best in Japan! The top spot is on the line, so you better bring it!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: You know I will. I'll race you with everything I've got.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: All righty… Here I go, Trainer!
